_comment: Pronunciation dictionary for narration (kamus pelafalan). ElevenLabs eleven_v3, mode A (language_code "id"). Every Arabic term in spoken narration is written exactly as `speak`; captions show `display`. Approved by the operator by ear on the Al-Fatihah 1 preview (2026-10-10). Rules: (1) grammar terms are spoken from Arabic script unless listed with a Latin respelling; (2) a term with a heavy letter (ص ض ط ظ ق خ غ) + fathah/alif MUST have a fixed respelling (v3 reads them light and inconsistently); (3) the narrator never speaks Qur'anic words, so no term may be (the front of) a word of any lesson surah: عَلَى was removed on 2026-10-10 because it is the front of عَلَيْهِمْ (1:7:4, 1:7:7). New terms are added only after the operator approves their sound; a term marked "approved": "pending-ear-check …" was added when the operator waived the pre-render review (2026-10-10) — it renders, and every validate/render run lists it until the operator has heard it and dates it.
